categories.main_business_segments: Sansure Biotech Inc. primarily operates in the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of diagnostic reagents and instruments, as well as third-party medical testing services. Their product portfolio covers infectious disease prevention, maternal and child health, blood safety, cancer prevention, companion diagnostics, and more, with over 1,000 products and 2,200 testing services offered globally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced molecular diagnostic technologies including fluorescence quantitative PCR, multiplex PCR, gene chips, gene sequencing, molecular POCT, nucleic acid mass spectrometry, immunodiagnostics, and bioinformatics. Key proprietary technologies include high-precision magnetic bead extraction, rapid one-step nucleic acid release, and fully automated sample processing platforms. They also integrate AI and digital technologies for intelligent disease prevention and control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sansure serves a broad customer base including hospitals, third-party independent laboratories, disease control centers, research institutions, and end consumers. Their products and services are applied in clinical diagnostics, public health, scientific research, and food safety sectors, with a strong presence in respiratory diseases, maternal and child health, blood-borne infections, oncology, and pharmacogenomics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively within China, with subsidiaries and offices in major cities such as Changsha, Shanghai, Beijing, and Chengdu. Internationally, Sansure has established subsidiaries and offices in countries including France, the United Kingdom, the United States, Indonesia, the Philippines, Canada, and others, serving over 160 countries and regions worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sansure Biotech operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IVD supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of diagnostic reagents and instruments, as well as providing third-party testing services. They also engage in upstream activities through strategic investments and partnerships to secure key raw materials and technologies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with a focus on upgrading its product matrix in respiratory, maternal and child health, blood infection, chronic disease management, immunodiagnostics, and sequencing. R&D priorities include molecular diagnostics simplification, precision, automation, system integration, and mobility, alongside AI-enabled digital transformation. They invest heavily in patent development and international certification to enhance global competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Sansure generates revenue primarily through the sales of diagnostic reagents, instruments, and testing services. Their sales channels include direct sales to large hospitals and laboratories, as well as distribution through qualified dealers. They also derive income from strategic investments and licensing related to their proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with multinational giants like Roche and Abbott, which hold dominant positions in the global IVD market. Sansure has established itself as a leading domestic player with strong market shares in respiratory infection and hepatitis prevention products, and growing presence in reproductive tract infection, genetic testing, and sequencing. It is recognized for breaking import monopolies and advancing domestic innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sansure achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.46 billion, representing a 44.78% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 275.6 million, with a 182.25% increase in net profit excluding non-recurring items. The company maintains strong cash flow generation and has total assets exceeding RMB 8.6 billion, reflecting steady growth and expanding scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sansure emphasizes delivering affordable, high-quality, and precise diagnostic technologies accessible to a broad population. Their competitive edge lies in proprietary core technologies, comprehensive product and service ecosystems covering the full diagnostic lifecycle, and integration of AI and digital platforms. They focus on innovation, quality, and customer-centric service to enable precision medicine and public health management globally.
